entries.description: Extended PlaywrightFixture with ClickDashboardNavCardAsync helper method

Added customer API helpers (GetCustomerByIdAsync, GetCustomersAsync, CreateCustomerAsync, UpdateCustomerAsync, CustomerSnapshot) and order mutation API helpers (UpdateOrderStatusAsync, AddOrderItemAsync, RemoveOrderItemAsync, GetOrderNotesAsync, AddOrderNoteAsync, UpdateOrderNoteAsync, DeleteOrderNoteAsync, OrderItemSnapshot, OrderNoteSnapshot)

Created NavigationTests.cs with 9 tests: 4 direct drawer navigation (Dashboard, Orders, Retail Businesses, Products), 4 drawer group navigation (Reports x2, Admin User Mgmt, Admin Product Mgmt), and 1 hamburger toggle test
Created DashboardWorkflowTests.cs with 3 tests: nav card to Orders, nav card to Products, report link to Orders by Retail Business

Fixed 2 pre-existing bugs discovered during testing: (1) removed stale dabbler-combobox.css reference from appsettings.json causing 404 errors, (2) fixed FilterSummaryBuilder.ToDictionary crash when filter columns share PropertyName (range filters like OrderDate from/to)

Build succeeded (0 errors). All 12 new Playwright tests pass. All 83 non-Playwright tests pass. 8 existing Playwright tests have pre-existing failures (layout assertions, admin page timeouts under concurrent load)
Cross-provider verification via AI Router (Gemini)

Extended PlaywrightFixture with form interaction helpers: GetFormInputAsync (handles MudBlazor 8.x testid-on-input rendering), FillFormFieldAsync, ClearFormFieldAsync, SelectFormDropdownAsync, SelectDropdownByLabelAsync, ClickSaveAsync, ClickUndoAsync, AssertSaveDisabledAsync, AssertSaveEnabledAsync
Extended PlaywrightFixture with grid interaction helpers: GetGridRowCountAsync, ClickGridRowAsync (with URL-change wait for Blazor Server async navigation), WaitForGridDataAsync

Created ProductsWorkflowTests.cs with 9 tests: list loads with columns, grid row click navigation, detail loads existing record, edit-save-verify-API, edit-undo-revert, toggle availability with API verification, back button, filter by RoastLevel with chip verification, filter by price range

Created CustomerCrudWorkflowTests.cs with 5 tests: list loads with data and column headers, detail loads existing record with field verification, edit-save-verify-API with phone field, edit-undo-revert, back button navigation

Created ValidationTests.cs with 5 tests: Product Name required validation, Product UnitPrice minimum boundary enforcement, Customer FirstName required, Customer LastName required, Customer Email required. All navigate through real UI controls to detail pages before triggering validation.

Build succeeded (0 errors). All 467 non-Playwright tests pass. All 19 new Playwright tests pass. Full Playwright suite: 36 passed, 7 failed (all pre-existing failures from SmokeTests, ProductAdministrationWorkflowTests, and MultiOrganizationWorkflowTests).
Cross-provider verification via AI Router

Extended PlaywrightFixture with dialog interaction helpers: WaitForDialogAsync, FillDialogFieldAsync, SubmitDialogAsync, CancelDialogAsync. Extended OrderSnapshot with Status, Total, OrderDate, ShipDate, Notes, OrderItems, OrderNotes, and StatusDisplayName.
Created OrdersWorkflowTests.cs with 4 orders list tests: list loads with columns visible, row click navigates to detail, status chips visible on rows, grid paging navigates correctly.

Added 4 order detail tests: header form loads with all fields visible and API-verified, status chip displays current status, back button returns to orders list, fields match API data cross-verified (customer name, status chip, items tab count, timestamps).
Added 2 items tab tests: displays correct item count and grid columns with row count matching API data, line total calculation correct (Qty * UnitPrice * (1 - Discount/100)).
Added 1 notes tab test: switch tab shows notes grid with Date, Author, Note columns and row count matching API data.

Added 2 read-only verification tests proving that the /orders/{id} page correctly hides mutation controls: status transition buttons not shown, item Add Product button not shown, note Add Note button not shown. This documents that the spec interactions 36-47 (status transitions, item CRUD, note CRUD) are not testable through the UI because OrderDetailPage.razor passes IsReadOnly=true.

Skipped note dialog validation tests (Note text required, Author required) because the order detail page renders with IsReadOnly=true, making the note dialog unreachable through the UI. Dialog helpers were still created for future use.

Build succeeded (0 errors). All 467 non-Playwright tests pass. All 13 new Playwright tests pass. Full Playwright suite: 49 passed, 7 failed (all pre-existing failures from SmokeTests, ProductAdministrationWorkflowTests, and MultiOrganizationWorkflowTests — same 7 as Session 2).
Cross-provider verification via AI Router
